data.title: Rejected-before against Claude Code's own memory, not against no memory
data.description: The first outside reviewer's objection: 'typically my agent session has context and keeps track of what I said, even if it was yesterday.' Every measurement we publish compares the hook with no hook. The baseline a user actually has is Claude Code with auto memory and a CLAUDE.md. If kadence adds nothing over that for one person on one machine, the page should say so and the pitch narrows to teams and tools; if it does, that is the number the hero should carry.
